question: Is the refinery pause over, yes or no?

lines.text: Drones have hit an oil refinery in Russia's Samara region, at Novokuibyshevsk.
Hours earlier, The Wall Street Journal said Ukraine had paused refinery strikes under US pressure.
Drone maker Fire Point says its F P one drones scored numerous hits there, including a diesel unit.
Monitoring channel Exilenova Plus counted at least eleven fires at the site.
Samara's governor says Ukraine is attacking the region, but gives no details.
The Rosneft plant refines about eight point eight million tonnes of oil a year.
Moscow's mayor says eight hundred and sixty two drones flew at the capital region overnight.
He says one hundred and seventy were downed approaching the city.
On Wednesday, Zelensky said Ukraine had paused refinery strikes for three days, while Russia kept hitting its energy.
Earlier this month, Trump said Zelensky better damn well stop the refinery attacks.
Now the Journal says this strike ends the pause.
Is the refinery pause over, yes or no?
